Patch notes

From Smite 2 Wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search

Patch notes are posts detailing changes and additions to the game as it is being developed. As SMITE 2 is in active development, patch notes are relatively frequent and can make significant changes to the game. Smaller hotfixes are sometimes released in between major patches, usually to address unexpected and problematic bugs in the game.

Lists of all posted patch notes can be found below. Official patch notes can also be read at https://www.smite2.com/news/.
